verdicts.reason: In both, the CTA button sits right against the end of 'alive' with almost no gap, so the headline and the button collide visually. The AUDIO COACHING / NO GEAR badges have shrunk to unreadable specks, the logo floats off-centre above the text, and the yellow circle peeks out awkwardly behind the CTA. B only shifts the phone and text block a little to the right, so the two are effectively the same layout with the same flaws.
